route_note: Take a train or bus from Surabaya to Malang (about 2-3 hours); trains run from Surabaya Gubeng/Pasar Turi to Malang station, then local transport reaches the city sights.
Drive or take a bus toward Mojokerto then a local angkot/ojeck to Trowulan; there is no direct rail station at the site, so the last leg is by road.
tour_query: Trowulan Majapahit day trip from Surabaya

route_note: Take a bus or train to Malang then a local bus/angkot up to Batu; the final leg from Malang is by road, roughly 30-45 minutes.
tour_query: Batu Malang day trip from Surabaya
